test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 04 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In the following triads, each group of letters is related to the subsequent one following a certain logic. Select from the given options, the one which follows the same logic.

TIPS - PTIS - SPIT

LOST - SLOT - TSOL
solution:
The logic followed here is:

TIPS - PTIS - SPIT

 
 T I P S 1, pos1->2, pos2->3, pos4->4 --> 
• 
• 
• 
• P T I S 1, pos1->2, pos3->3, pos2->4 --> 
• 
• 
• 
• S P I T 

And,

LOST - SLOT - TSOL

 
 L O S T 1, pos1->2, pos2->3, pos4->4 --> 
• 
• 
• 
• S L O T 1, pos1->2, pos3->3, pos2->4 --> 
• 
• 
• 
• T S O L 

Similarly,

SPIN - ISPN - NIPS

 
 S P I N 1, pos1->2, pos2->3, pos4->4 --> 
• 
• 
• 
• I S P N 1, pos1->2, pos3->3, pos2->4 --> 
• 
• 
• 
• N I P S 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
